Synopsis:
Volo is at players' camp. He shares some revelations when first time spoken to, but otherwise this is his default in-camp dialog.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Volo.json: Volo (Volothamp Geddarm) is at the player’s camp after the party intervened at the Steel Watch Foundry — the player tampered with the foundry’s neural switchboard and prevented an explosion that would have killed him. He’s grateful but rattled, having been publicly accused and nearly executed by an angry crowd and hostile agents, so he asked to speak privately rather than risk more exposure. In camp he gives a dramatic warning: he believes Bhaal has returned, names Orin the Red as a possible Chosen who can become the Slayer, and claims a rare tome—A Study of the Slayer by Irenicus—contains the knowledge needed to stop it. Volo is theatrical and prone to absent-mindedness (he treasures the book but may misplace it), earnest about the threat, and eager to recruit a brave adventurer to act.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntCelebration_Volo.json: Volo's dialog after the goblin hunt celebration party. Occurs whether tieflings or raiders win, with a variation for whether we've met Volo or not. This is his fallback in being added to our camp.In the tiefling victory variation, Volo is sitting at his desk and thinking/writing an account of our victory that day. As we approach he should set down his pen and turn to speak with us, only returning to work again once he's dismissed us.In the goblin victory celebration, Volo is standing in a cage much like the one in which he is placed in the goblin camp. In this case, he does not wish to be freed. He isn't writing anything or holding anything, but hands off his notes off-screen if intimidated into doing so.
- GOB_VoloBallad_Volo_FestivitiesArea.json: Volo, a reknowned scholar, has been captured by goblins and is being forced to sing on a stage at their celebratory party following a raid. One goblin has the responsibility of guarding him and engages him in conversation. If the goblins are killed, he investigates the corpses, researching the cause of death.
- DEN_VoloTravel.json: Volo is a canonical character in DnD. He's known for being the realm's go-to guy for compiling information. In this take, he fulfils that role but puts a twist on what he sees. He's keenly curious for facts but likes to embellish them. A bit like Gilderoy Lockheart. He IS talented, but his reputation has gotten away from him, too. In this dialogue, Volo will offer to put his knowledge at your service if you confide you've been infected with a mindflayer. He'll perform an icepick lobotomy that'll leave you without an eye or much in the way of apology from Volo. He should be clever, a little arrogant, very English, and very fun, without being a cartoon character.
